name: Oaks Italian Deli And Pizzeria
description: Oaks Italian Deli And Pizzeria at 1570 Egypt Rd, Phoenixville. Call 610-666-0280. Open late most nights.

hero.headline: Oaks Italian Deli And Pizzeria
hero.sub: 1570 Egypt Rd, Phoenixville. Deli counter and pizza from the same shop. Call 610-666-0280. Monday through Thursday 10 to 10, Friday and Saturday 10 to 11, Sunday 11 to 9.

offerings.heading: Deli in the name. <mark>Pizza on the board.</mark>
items: Italian deli sandwiches built at the counter, not assembled from a frozen pack.
Pizzeria pies for the nights the table wants a box, not a hoagie.
Order online when you already know the ticket, or call 610-666-0280.
Deli and pizzeria in one shop

story.heading: Egypt Road, Phoenixville
paragraphs: Oaks Italian Deli And Pizzeria sits at 1570 Egypt Rd. The name is the offer. You can leave with a sandwich or a pie.
Hours run late most nights. Sunday is the short day. Call 610-666-0280 if the line at the counter is long.

experience.heading: How the counter should work.
items: Walk in on Egypt Road. Read the board. Order at the deli or ask for a pie.
Online ordering exists for the nights you don't want to stand there.
If something's wrong, ask for the manager. They say they listen.

feature.heading: One shop for the sandwich and the pie
feature.text: Plenty of places make you choose deli or pizza. Oaks put both on Egypt Road, with hours that cover a late Friday.

contact.heading: Egypt Road is the <mark>address.</mark>
contact.sub: 1570 Egypt Rd, Phoenixville. Confirm a holiday close on the official site.
